# Internal development evidence

This directory retains release checklists, historical backend audits,
checkpoint logs, consolidation records, and implementation roadmaps for
maintainer review. They remain normal GitHub-rendered Markdown, but are kept
below `.github/internal/` so pkgdown does not publish historical engineering
records as user-facing package documentation.

Public behavior, setup, limitations, and supported workflows belong in the
README, reference pages, vignettes, NEWS, and the current 0.3 roadmap.
